entry.offlineSmoke: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python -m py_compile agent/prompt.py agent/development_experiment.py agent/strands_evaluators.py
entry.faultyBaseline: uv run --project agent --locked opentelemetry-instrument python talk/run-faulty-experiment.py --suite "$PHASE18_SUITE" --evaluator "$PHASE18_EVALUATOR" --output-root "$PHASE18_BASELINE_EXPERIMENTS"
entry.run: uv run --project agent --locked opentelemetry-instrument python agent/development_experiment.py run --suite "$PHASE18_SUITE" --candidate repaired --evaluator "$PHASE18_EVALUATOR" --output-root "$PHASE18_EXPERIMENTS"
entry.continuedRun: uv run --project agent --locked opentelemetry-instrument python agent/development_experiment.py run --suite "$PHASE18_SUITE" --candidate repaired --source-run "$PHASE22_S3_RUN" --evaluator "$PHASE18_EVALUATOR" --output-root "$PHASE18_EXPERIMENTS"
entry.show: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python agent/development_experiment.py show --experiment "$PHASE22_EXPERIMENT"
entry.compare: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python agent/development_experiment.py compare --baseline "$PHASE22_BASELINE_EXPERIMENT" --candidate "$PHASE22_EXPERIMENT"
entry.policy: S4 must run the full native suite; a focused case is supplementary only. S4 is advisory developer feedback and does not qualify or publish the Runtime ZIP.
